claims.claim: This is a motor speed reducer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a gear reducer/speed reducer unit with flange and bore consistent with this description

risks.risk: Brand, model, gear ratio and power rating unknown, affecting compatibility and value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of nameplate/label or stamped markings on housing
risks.if_unproven: price as unbranded/generic unit, worst case

risks.risk: Condition of internal gears and bearings (wear, noise, backlash) cannot be seen
risks.proof: Video of unit running or being hand-turned showing smooth rotation and no abnormal noise
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown working condition, worst case (assume needs repair)

risks.risk: New vs used vs refurbished status unverifiable
risks.proof: Close-up of shaft, bolts, and housing paint wear plus seller's purchase/import documentation if any

risks.risk: Rust, cracks, or hidden damage not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including underside and shaft ends
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically/functionally unverified, worst case

risks.risk: Input/output shaft dimensions and flange size unknown, affecting compatibility
risks.proof: Photo with a ruler/tape measure against shaft and flange, or stamped dimension markings
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown compatibility, worst case (buyer bears adaptation cost)

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any nameplate, label, or stamped model/serial number
Video of the unit running or shaft being turned by hand
Photos from additional angles (top, underside, both shaft ends)
Photo with a measuring tape showing shaft diameter and flange dimensions
Any purchase receipt or documentation showing age/origin
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a gear/speed reducer matching the seller's claim, but brand, condition, and specs are unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case as a generic, condition-unknown used unit.
